Injection')"}], "description": "### Impact

`quote()` emits a `{ comment }` token as `#` followed by its text, which comments out the rest of the shell line, including the opening quote of any later string token. A line terminator in that later string ends the comment, and the rest of the string is parsed as shell input:

```js
quote(['echo', 'ok', { comment: 'x' }, 'a\nid;#']);
// echo ok #x 'a
// id;#'
```

Passed to `sh`, `bash`, `dash`, `ksh`, or `zsh`, this runs `id`.

`parse()` emits a comment token for a `#` in the middle of a word (for example `http://example.com/#frag`), so callers that combine `parse()` output with another untrusted string, such as `quote(parse(untrustedCommand).concat(untrustedArg))`, are affected. The fix for CVE-2026-9277 rejected line terminators in the comment's own text, but not in the tokens after it.

Exploitation requires an attacker-controlled string containing a line terminator that follows a `{ comment }` token in the same `quote()` call.

### Patches

Fixed in v1.11.0: `quote()` throws a `TypeError` when a string after a `{ comment }` token contains a line terminator (`\n`, `\r`, U+2028, or U+2029).

### Workarounds

Drop every token after a `{ comment }` token before calling `quote()`, or reject line terminators in untrusted strings. Separately, do not append other shell text after `quote()` output that contains a comment, since the comment swallows it.", "epss": {"percentage": 0.00383, "percentile": 0.29703}, "ghsa_id": "GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv", "github_reviewed_at": "2026-10-06T13:40:36Z", "html_url": "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv", "identifiers": [{"type": "GHSA", "value": "GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv"}, {"type": "CVE", "value": "CVE-2026-102422"}], "nvd_published_at": "2026-09-29T04:17:55Z", "published_at": "2026-10-06T13:40:36Z", "references": ["https://github.com/ljharb/shell-quote/security/advisories/GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv", "https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-102422", "https://github.com/ljharb/shell-quote/commit/6002b2ed90c6b83095eb272b6b0adaf3a172b0bc", "https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv"], "repository_advisory_url": "https://api.github.com/repos/ljharb/shell-quote/security-advisories/GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv", "severity": "critical", "source_code_location": "https://github.com/ljharb/shell-quote", "summary": "shell-quote: `quote()` command injection via a line terminator in a token after a `{ comment }` token", "type": "reviewed", "updated_at": "2026-10-06T13:40:37Z", "url": "https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv", "vulnerabilities": [{"first_patched_version": "1.11.0", "package": {"ecosystem": "npm", "name": "shell-quote"}, "vulnerable_functions": [], "vulnerable_version_range": ">= 1.8.4, < 1.11.0"}], "withdrawn_at": null}
